svg.title: Latent upscaling of the whole frame and the three-step noise schedule
svg.desc: Panel a draws the 36 by 64 native latent grid and the 90 by 160 upscaled grid to scale, both showing the same whole frame: the upscaler enlarges every latent 2.5 times per side, so an 8 by 8 block becomes a 20 by 20 block; nothing is padded. Panel b plots the noise level sigma at each of the three Euler steps: 0.909, 0.857, 0.667 and 0, with step sizes 0.052, 0.190 and 0.667.
svg.text: a · LATENT UPSCALING, DRAWN TO SCALE
the whole frame is enlarged: every latent → 2.5 × 2.5 latents, no padding
drawn to scale · grid lines every 2 latents · 37 latent frames unchanged

g.text: The final Euler step spans the largest Δσ interval.
